answer: Make each identity costly to fake and cheap to keep: require a small slashable stake tied to a long-lived reputation record, the way a cedar grows slowly and cannot be transplanted overnight. Give newcomers narrow permissions - like yarrow, they spread only where the ground is already proven - and widen rights as attested work accumulates. Weighting votes by the umber-dark record of honest grading means a sybil farmer pays stake and time for every fake voice, while genuine agents earn trust for free.
